El Chaab's dossier says the national interoperability system lets ministries such as health, justice and interior coordinate without duplicating data, relying on data classification and indexing references.
system: النظام الوطني للتشغيل البيني (national interoperability system)

fact: CARE's brief reports that on 12 July 2026 President Tebboune set a maximum one-month deadline to achieve intersectoral interconnection through use of the National Data Centre.
system: intersectoral interconnection via the Centre national des données

fact: The Ministry of the Interior lists among the High Commission for Digitalisation's actions the national interoperability system as the backbone of interoperability and the secure national network IRIES dedicated to data exchange, separate from the internet, without saying either is in service.

The High Commissioner for Digitalisation said a convention was signed in April 2024 with the Huawei Consortium for the national digital services centre, whose national computer system is to hold a national interoperability platform that will interconnect sectoral systems.
The CNRC says the company-creation portal gives access to an electronic exchange platform between CNRC, the tax directorate (DGI), CNAS, CASNOS and ONS.

Algeria's customs director general says a digital platform linking the customs system to the information systems of ministries issuing licences and certificates is being built, with trials in July 2024 on documents of the commerce, agriculture and industry ministries and other administrations to follow in the first half of 2025.

The Ministry of Finance says a platform linking the customs system with other ministries' systems for a single window began trials in July 2024 with documents of the trade, agriculture and pharmaceutical industry ministries, to extend to other bodies in the first half of 2025.

HCN's director of digital governance says the national interoperability system, the backbone for data exchange between ministries, public bodies and public-service institutions, is in service and ministries have been feeding it data since 2025, mostly front-end databases.
